<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sigmafi/orders"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Borrowers' orders waiting for a lender, newest first. Unconfirmed orders are included and orders already being spent are not. `collateral` keeps orders whose collateral holds that token, or any ERG with `erg`; `loan` keeps orders borrowing that token, or ERG with `erg`. Each order says why this client would not fill it, when it would not.
